items.text: Messed around with this game for about an hour, still have no clue what im doing. Why am i hearing beeping? Why is my battery reserve lowering? Also i don't have any task, it just tells me to check my inventory, which i did and the task still doesn't go away. I'm just thrown into the mix and expected what to do. Also the flying mechanic makes me want to scream and i still just end up crashing into things and am forced to restart, please to god make the flying idiot proof.  I loved Neo Scavenger a lot, and was really excited for this game but i can't recommend it right now, it just needs a bit of work.
items.text_zh: 玩了大约一个小时这个游戏，仍然完全不知道我在做什么。为什么我听到哔哔声？为什么我的电池储备在下降？而且我没有任何任务，它只是告诉我去检查我的库存，我检查了，任务仍然没有消失。我就这样被扔进混战里，还被期望知道该做什么。还有飞行机制让我想尖叫，我最终还是撞到东西上并被迫重新开始，求求老天让飞行变得傻瓜式简单。我非常喜欢Neo Scavenger，对这款游戏真的很兴奋，但我现在不能推荐它，它只是需要一点打磨。

observations.description: 玩家不清楚游戏目标和玩法
observations.evidence: still have no clue what im doing
observations.evidence_zh: 仍然完全不知道自己在做什么
